title: Generate pseudopotentials for Pd and N
action: Generate Troullier-Martins norm-conserving pseudopotentials for Pd and N using specified atomic configurations and cut-off radii, with LDA exchange-correlation.
description: Produce pseudopotential files required for all subsequent DFT calculations.

title: DFT total-energy scans for four structures
action: Run Siesta DFT calculations for ZB, RS, CsCl, and WZ structures over a range of lattice constants, relaxing atomic positions, and collect total energy vs. lattice constant data.
description: Produce raw energy-volume points for each phase. Used by the subsequent EOS fitting step.

title: Extract equilibrium structural properties
action: Fit Murnaghan equation of state to the energy-volume data to obtain equilibrium lattice constants, bulk modulus, pressure derivative, and minimum total energy for each structure. Determine energetic ordering and compute the energy differences relative to the structure with lowest E0.
description: Scored artifact reporting the fitted structural parameters and energetic ordering. The energy_above_ground column is relative to the phase with minimum total energy (the predicted ground state). Compared to paper-reported values with tolerances.
output_schema: CSV with columns: structure, a0 (angstrom), B (GPa), Bprime (dimensionless), E0 (eV/atom), energy_above_ground (eV/atom, relative to the ground-state phase). For WZ rows, additional columns: c0 (angstrom), u (dimensionless), c_a (dimensionless).

title: Compute elastic constants of the most stable phase
action: Apply the volume-conserving strain technique: generate a set of small distortive strains for the predicted ground-state cell at its equilibrium lattice constant, run DFT, and fit energy-strain data to obtain C11, C12, C44.
description: Produce raw strain-energy data and derive the elastic constants C11, C12, C44 for the most stable phase identified in step 3.

title: Derive mechanical and thermo-elastic properties for the most stable phase
action: From C11, C12, C44 and the bulk modulus B (from the equilibrium fit of the ground-state phase), compute all derived properties using the formulas given in the paper: shear modulus G (Voigt-Reuss-Hill average), Young's modulus E, Poisson's ratio nu, Zener anisotropy A, Kleinman parameter zeta, Lamé constants lambda and mu, longitudinal, transverse, and average sound velocities, and Debye temperature.
description: Final scored artifact containing elastic constants and all derived mechanical/thermal parameters for the most stable phase. The checker recomputes derived quantities to verify internal consistency and compares to paper-reported values.
output_schema: CSV with one row, columns: C11, C12, C44 (GPa), G (GPa), E (GPa), nu (dimensionless), A (dimensionless), zeta (dimensionless), lambda (GPa), mu (GPa), B (GPa), vl (m/s), vt (m/s), vm (m/s), theta_D (K).
